qs.q: A 55-year-old hypertensive patient presents with swelling and decreased urine output. Labs: BUN 45 mg/dL, Creatinine 3.8 mg/dL, Na⁺ 134 mmol/L, K⁺ 5.2 mmol/L. Urine Na⁺ 500 mOsm/kg. What is the likely cause?
qs.e: Low urine sodium (<20) and high urine osmolality (>500) indicate intact tubular function trying to conserve sodium and water.
